One clear path

Every SQA concept, in the order you need it.

Eight stages from the QA mindset to your first job — each lesson tagged beginner, intermediate or advanced so you always know where you are.

Learn · practise · prove

A complete learning lab for testers.

Read it, see it, try it, then prove it. Every concept connects to practice you can do right now.

Learning Lab

Structured lessons with visuals, worked examples, key terms, practice exercises with model answers and a quick check after every lesson.

Visual guidesWorked examplesInterview questions

Test Center

Module quizzes, timed level exams and scenario-based case studies. Review every answer with an explanation and track your weak topics.

Practice drills

Sort bugs by severity, order the bug life cycle, spot weak test steps, fill in status codes.

Interview prep

Realistic questions with model answers, hints and self-scoring rubrics.

Hands-on labs

Six simulated apps — login, API, checkout, mobile, UI widgets and a seeded bug hunt.

Progress you can see

XP, levels, streaks, badges and a clear dashboard of what to learn next — saved privately in this browser.

Challenges & code workspace

Write Playwright, Cypress or Selenium drafts, test cases and your approach, then get transparent rubric feedback.

Learn in your language

English first. Explained in yours.

Lessons are written in English — the language of QA interviews — and every lesson adds a simple explanation in اردو, Roman Urdu, हिन्दी, العربية and Español. Switch any time.

English

Test on and next to every boundary: for 1–10, try 0, 1, 10 and 11.

اردو

ہر حد پر اور اس کے بالکل ساتھ والی قیمتیں ٹیسٹ کریں: 1 سے 10 کے لیے 0، 1، 10 اور 11۔

हिन्दी

हर सीमा पर और उसके ठीक बगल वाली values test करें: 1–10 के लिए 0, 1, 10 और 11।
